stage1_inventory.frozen_evaluation_set: The 150-row held-out split (seed d5a-m4-finqa-split-v1, 0.7 calibration fraction, class-stratified) of a 500-row scored subset. FinQA carries the human labels. FinanceBench is the retrieval corpus and has no hallucination labels.

persisted_scores.score_semantics: faithfulness_score in {0.0, 0.5, 1.0}. detector_score = 1 - faithfulness_score, so a higher value means more likely a hallucination.

coverage_on_the_150_row_frozen_set.flash_tier_faithfulness: 0/150: no flash judge score exists for a labeled row
coverage_on_the_150_row_frozen_set.higher_resolution_rubric_variant: 0/150: the variant does not exist yet

incompatible_evidence_not_used.live_judge_verdicts: SEC traffic, none of its trace ids is a benchmark id
incompatible_evidence_not_used.canary_observations: 30 categorical rubric decisions on ids outside the 500

heldout_150.cost_basis: usage-metadata estimate at the Vertex standard-tier constants, not billing

all_scored_500.cost_basis: usage-metadata estimate at the Vertex standard-tier constants, not billing

stage2_replay.NOT_EVALUATED_flash_only: No flash scores exist for the labeled rows. Nothing is extrapolated.

flash_plus_10_percent_frontier.status: not evaluated: it needs flash scores on every row
flash_plus_10_percent_frontier.sampling_rule: should_sample_for_frontier(id, 10): SHA-256 of the row id modulo 10 equals 0. This is the platform's own rule. It never reads a label, and it depends only on the id, so the same rows are sampled in every comparison.
flash_plus_10_percent_frontier.combination_rule: A sampled row takes the frontier detector_score and every other row takes the flash detector_score. Both are 1 - faithfulness but come from different prompts, so the mixed ranking is reported only beside the paired flash and frontier scores on the sampled rows.
flash_plus_10_percent_frontier.reporting_rule: Report the policy's realized accuracy on its sampled subset and its estimated cost over all traffic as two separate figures. Never compare the subset against the full-set flash baseline as if equivalent.

REPLAYED_frontier_component_on_sampled_r.metrics: withheld: fewer than 5 rows in one class

flash_plus_10_percent_frontier.estimated_full_operating_cost: not computable: it needs the flash cost per row

stage2_replay.crossover: NOT ESTABLISHED. It needs three policy points and one cannot be computed. The literature value of about 20 percent is neither confirmed nor refuted here.

judge_resolution.variant: NOT_EVALUATED: not written and not run

resolution_variant_lower_bound.basis: holdout rows times the measured mean rubric call cost; a finer score needs more output tokens, so this is a floor
